text:
We returned to Israel with two cats and a dog. You basically need a valid rabies vaccine, international chip and rabies antibodies test results. There are requirements what has to come first, time in between etc. it is recommended to start the process few months in advance because the rabies test results might take time.
The best is to send an email to the vet at the airport at: vs-airport@moag.gov.il
They usually answer fast and will instruct you what’s needed. 
You don’t need an import license! 
They will email you the health certificate that a govt. vet in your country has to sign. 
48 hours before the flight you email them all the docs and they give you the approval to bring your pet. 
It sounds complicated maybe, but take a deep breath, it’s doable! 
If you have more questions send me a message
